item.title: Trump threatens tariffs on any country selling oil to Cuba, a move that puts pressure on Mexico
item.description: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said her government had temporarily stopped oil shipments to Cuba.

item.title: Renck: Why Ray Bourque raising Stanley Cup should inspire current Avalanche team
item.description: In the 2000-2001 season, a 40-year-old defenseman's hunger provided the rudder. Those Avs were good enough to win without him. But they won because of him. Can the Avs do it again this season?

item.title: Broncos’ QBs coach Davis Webb withdraws from Raiders’ coaching search, source confirms
item.description: Outwardly, at least, Sean Payton isn't much concerned about coaching against Davis Webb twice a year.

item.title: Ochs family, a legacy and the children who pass it along
item.description: On Tuesday, Craig, the once-upon-a-time sports star, took his place on the purple bleachers at Holy Family High School, assuming only the role of dad.

item.title: Pedestrian hit by RTD train near Colorado station
item.description: One person taken to the hospital after they were hit by a Regional Transportation District train in south Denver on Thursday evening, police officials said.

item.title: Colorado blitzed early, routed by No. 8 Iowa State
item.description: It didn’t start off horribly. At least not for the first few moments.

item.title: Scott Wedgewood struggles, Avalanche blown out 7-3 by Canadiens: “That’s a goalie loss”
item.description: The Colorado Avalanche struggled in all phases Thursday night and got blown out, 7-3, by the Montreal Canadiens at Bell Centre.

item.title: Colorado Buffs snap Big 12 road skid, knock off Kansas State
item.description: MANHATTAN, Kan. – In crunch time on the road this season, the Colorado women’s basketball team has faltered. On Thursday night, the Buffaloes turned the tide.

item.title: Aurora Public Schools, Adams 14 to close Friday due to staff absences on day of ICE Out protests
item.description: The announcements come ahead of Friday's nationwide ICE Out protests and general strike following the deaths of Renee Good and Alex Pretti in Minneapolis.
